comparison_reference.name: Tiny Swords by Pixel Frog
comparison_reference.notes: The published medieval building set provides a comparison for distinct silhouettes, readable building functions and architecture that belongs to a shared top-down map.

professional_quality.evidence: Both forms gain usable volume from visible side planes. Their shared platform and similar centered dormers make the pair look like one building template with two wall treatments.
professional_quality.guidance: Compare finish against a named professional reference; explain remaining weaknesses.

readability.evidence: At 1x the chimney, circular attic window and blue glazing distinguish the cottage. Red plank frontage and X-braced doors distinguish the barn.
readability.guidance: Identify each subject at native resolution from silhouette and proportions.

pixel_clustering.evidence: At 3x the roof courses, timber, glazing and wall planes stay grouped in coherent pixel clusters. Cliff-like stepping on the roof edges remains confined to the intended silhouette.
pixel_clustering.guidance: Inspect clusters for noise, isolated pixels, banding and accidental geometry.

color_and_lighting.evidence: Upper-left facing roof planes and pale masonry separate from the cooler/darker side walls. Teal and terracotta distinguish the two without changing lighting direction.
color_and_lighting.guidance: Check palette harmony, volume, light direction and controlled contrast.

materials.evidence: Cottage glazing and barn planks read. The diagonal roof joins have large angular highlights, and the identical slab treatment makes foundations read as a repeated UI-like plinth.
materials.guidance: Explain how each material reads through its structure rather than generic pattern noise.

specialized_design.evidence: The barn shows a double-slope wall profile and crossed doors, yet a centered house-like dormer and narrow entry visually dominate its working agricultural form.
specialized_design.guidance: Check anatomy, architecture and characteristic features of the subject.

artistic_detail.evidence: The round cottage window and planter provide useful personality. Empty side expanses and repeated rectangular footings leave the finish close to a composed blockout.
artistic_detail.guidance: Assess depth, personality and finish beyond a merely acceptable primitive.

originality.evidence: Both side walls and multi-plane roof returns add actual geometry compared with the baseline front elevation. The two roof types, doors and siding show separate authored cues.
originality.guidance: Compare with prior and rejected work; explain new geometry and legitimate reuse.

consistency.evidence: Both roofs show a similar top-down camera and right side depth, grounded in restrained palettes and the same one-pixel exterior outline treatment.
consistency.guidance: Compare scale, perspective, style and detail density within the intended catalog.

technical_integrity.evidence: The 238 by 120 PNG has two expected components, zero singletons, 80 colors and 7 px or more edge clearance. Both buildings are fully visible.
technical_integrity.guidance: Verify dimensions, transparency, borders, directions and absence of deformation.

game_readiness.evidence: Only a composed comparison sheet is delivered. Per-building placement origins, collision footprints and Y-sort alignment remain unverified for map integration.
game_readiness.guidance: Verify complete views/states/animations and integration without manual repair.
